project_name: Workplace Safety Sentinel (Physical AI Edge Perception)
author: Embedded SF Hackathon Team

hardware_target.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6GB VRAM)

requirement_prompt: Build an edge vision perception pipeline using PipeGen that monitors an industrial work area in real-time. Ingest a video stream or camera feed, detect workers and personnel with YOLOv8, classify PPE compliance (helmets/vests), track worker trajectories with persistent IDs across restricted hazard zones (heavy machinery zones), trigger instant safety violations over MQTT, and log structured incident telemetry to JSON audit logs with sub-15ms TensorRT inference latency.
tasks: Telemetry Dispatch (MQTT & JSON Incident Audit Log)
